This section collects statistics tutorials in R for modelling, prediction, and data analysis. Topics include linear regression, `geom_smooth()`, artificial neural networks, Bayesian statistics, multiple testing, Simpson's paradox, and applied statistical workflows.

## Featured statistics tutorials

- [How `geom_smooth()` makes linear model predictions](posts/linear_prediction/) compares `ggplot2`, `lm()`, and `predict()` using historical cholera data.
- [Plain vanilla neural network from scratch in R](posts/plain_vanilla/) explains activation functions, weights, and backpropagation without hiding the mechanics.
- [R-Ladies event text analysis](posts/rladies/) uses Meetup event data, tidy text methods, and word cloud visualization.
- [Bayesian statistics model comparison](posts/bayesian_statistics/) compares Bayesian model packages, priors, likelihoods, and posterior inference.
- [Predictive modelling in R](posts/predictive_modeling/) compares caret and tidymodels for preprocessing, resampling, training, and evaluation.
